<!-- pr-reviewer: 90c8810a9e571bca70b6b2569346fec3f5d412bf -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

What looks good
- The new Plasma cutting row reuses the existing undoable `LoadBuiltinMachine` path (`set_machine_mode`, unchanged), so there is no new command. An MCP follow-up is not needed, because the machine-load tool already covers it.
- Switching modes only changes which machine is mounted. The milling-ops-on-plasma refusal is the existing `posting_family` law, and plasma_post_refusals still passes. The PR adds no posting change and no G-code change.
- Guard tests pin the table: `every_kind_with_a_shipped_machine_has_a_mode` and `every_mode_mounts_a_shipped_machine_of_its_own_kind`. The Milling -> Plasma -> Milling round trip checks the two undos and that a repeated pick mounts nothing.
- The UI checks are structural (AccessKit/row text). No snapshot PNG is touched. A decision file is present and there is no CHANGELOG edit. The body ends `Fixes #1195` and has a `Changelog:` line.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` was added, and the `mode_label` fallback is `"Machine"`.

Local results (trial merge with upstream/main: already up to date, no conflicts; no build.rs, scripts, `.github` or dependency changes)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib -- --test-threads=1` (CWD crates/ui) | 581 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| ui suites boundary, boundary_picks, machine, theme_files | 3, 6, 6, 14 passed |
| app plasma_profile, plasma_post, plasma_post_refusals | 7, 5, 7 passed |
| app machine, posting | 33, 17 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Requested before merge
- None.

Questions / notes (not blocking)
1. `panes.rs:343`: `mode_caption` now returns the long row text. It also feeds the ribbon door cell (`format!("{}…", mode_caption(..))`), not only the dropdown. The cell therefore reads "Plasma cutting - Plasma…" or "Mill-turning - Turning…" instead of a single word. The doc comment on `mode_caption` (panes.rs:315) still says "the Title-case word the door wears". The text-only tests cannot show whether it clips in the narrow ribbon cell. Please eyeball it at 1280 px, as with the dropdown width the body already flags. If it clips, keep the short caption for the cell and use `mode_label` only for the rows.
2. The "Turning - Turning" row is redundant, as already noted.
3. `actions.rs` is now 458 lines, past the ~400-line guideline. This is not blocking; moving `mode_label` out in a follow-up is sensible.
4. The PR does not touch process files, so no `PROCESS_VERSION` bump is needed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
